selection_rule: One V2 candidate per arm. Compare each V2 with unchanged V1 on the pre-saved Selection task. Retain V2 for deployment if formal success improves, or if equal success and F2P/P2P counts do not regress; otherwise retain V1. Technical missing grades are inconclusive and deployment retains V1. Test all pre-saved V1 and V2 candidates regardless of selection, clearly distinguishing deployed choice. No Test feedback in extraction or selection.
V2_training: Each arm independently solves the same two new Development tasks using its unchanged V1. The update receives its own V1, the original arm-specific Development intermediate analysis (provenance: fixed D01-D08 cohort), and its own two new trajectories with identical per-field clipping and input caps. Original old raw evidence remains archived; it is represented by the prior analysis during incremental update. No Selection/Test information enters extraction. On-policy new data differ intentionally; V2 comparison is not an identical-evidence alignment ablation.
K0_v2: Teacher sees only old and new Development public descriptions and own knowledge, never student traces/solutions.
hint_transfer: Four frozen libraries generated in equal two-call budget from the corresponding prior independent NoHint/Error/Strategy/Exploration Development attempt. Same model/word budget. Teacher-free independent new Test; compare with B0 on the same new Test. Source tasks, feedback and result quality differ; do not claim pure Hint-style causality.
scope_limits: Finite exploratory completion; no required positive result/statistical significance, no weight training or new Scene RSI. Scene audit remains explicit about rendered-image coverage.
